leadText:
Jared (Japanese: タクミ Takumi) is a character of the day who appeared in the Pokémon Chronicles episode Putting the Air Back in Aerodactyl!.

Jared is a research assistant in the Sayda Lab, a part of the research team headed by Dora. He's put in charge of escorting and to Sayda Island and helps in the search for the missing . He was very excited to show Tracey and Professor Oak how well Gary had been doing.

Jared's character was not developed very much, as he had very little on-screen time and not many speaking parts, but he is a valued assistant to the research team at Sayda Laboratory.
